name: Find Agmond
summary: Weeks have passed without word from Prospector Agmond at the Badlands digs. Prospector Ironband now needs you to find Agmond and bring back his report.

sections.title: A Silent Prospector
sections.body: Prospector Agmond oversaw the Badlands excavations southwest of Ironband. Ironband calls him a prospector no longer, for weeks have passed without word. He needs you to find Agmond and recover the report. Agmond was last heard from at the southernmost dig, a small outfit beyond Angor Fortress. Begin there.

sections.title: Where the Trail Ends
sections.body: At the end of your search, you find a skeleton that must be what remains of Agmond. The body is broken and battered, and the bones have been picked clean.

faq.answer: Prospector Agmond oversaw the excavations in the Badlands, southwest of Prospector Ironband.

faq.q: Why is Prospector Ironband looking for Agmond?
faq.answer: Prospector Ironband has heard nothing from Agmond in weeks and needs his report.

faq.q: Where was Prospector Agmond last known to be?
faq.answer: Agmond was last heard from at the southernmost Badlands dig, a small outfit beyond Angor Fortress.
